concepts.name: 01-scan-frame
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished iOS document scanner app icon concept, square image, full bleed opaque background. Flat 2D vector-like graphic, crisp clean edges, friendly geometric construction, bold distinctive silhouette legible at 32px. Existing app uses cobalt blue #145FE8, mint teal #09BFA5 and white. Centered mark occupying about 64% of canvas, generous balanced margins. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, mockup, borders, gradients, texture, lighting, shadows, 3D or extra illustrations. Do not round outer canvas corners; OS mask is applied later. Original identity, not another app's logo. Solid cobalt blue background. A white upright sheet of paper with a small folded top-right corner, two short cobalt text strokes inside; four thick, short mint scanner corner brackets neatly surround the sheet. A balanced exceptionally simple scan identity.
